# VirtualTour

> Guided product tours and onboarding for web pages. Spotlights an element, explains it in a popover and walks the user through steps. Plain JS/TS (`virtual-site-tour`), React (`virtual-site-tour-react`) and Vue (`virtual-site-tour-vue`). MIT, ESM only, no runtime dependencies, fork of driver.js 1.12.1.

Live demo: https://quaz579.github.io/virtualtour/
Repository: https://github.com/quaz579/virtualtour

Rules an integrating agent must follow:

- Always import `virtual-site-tour/base.css` (required). `virtual-site-tour/theme.css` is optional (colors, dark mode). `virtual-site-tour/avatar.css` only with the avatar presenter, imported after the other two.
- `dim` defaults to off. Pass `dim: true` for the darkened overlay with a cut-out around the target.
- A step with `target` and no `placement` highlights the target and centers the popover. Set `placement: { side: "bottom" }` to anchor it to the target.
- `createTour` is safe during server rendering; `tour.start()` needs a browser (rejects with `TourEnvironmentError` otherwise). Start from a click handler, an effect, or `autoStart` on the framework provider.
- React and Vue: wrap the UI in `<TourProvider config={...}>` and call `useTour()` in a child component. There is no Vue plugin and no `app.use`.
- Popover DOM for tests: `.vt-popover`, `.vt-popover-title`, `.vt-popover-description`, `.vt-popover-next-btn`, `.vt-popover-prev-btn`, `.vt-popover-close-btn`; the highlighted element gets class `vt-target`; the overlay is `svg.vt-overlay`. Keyboard: Escape exits, ArrowRight/ArrowLeft move.

## Quickstart: no build step (CDN)

No `package.json` or bundler? Load the ESM build and stylesheets from a CDN. Save this as `index.html` and serve the folder with any static server (for example `python3 -m http.server 8000`); `type="module"` scripts do not run from `file://`. Pin the version.

```html
<!doctype html>
<html lang="en">
  <head>
    <meta charset="utf-8" />
    <link rel="stylesheet" href="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/virtual-site-tour@1.0.3/dist/base.css" />
    <link rel="stylesheet" href="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/virtual-site-tour@1.0.3/dist/theme.css" />
  </head>
  <body>
    <button id="save">Save</button>
    <button id="start-tour">Take the tour</button>

    <script type="module">
      import { createTour } from "https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/virtual-site-tour@1.0.3/dist/index.js";

      const tour = createTour({
        id: "welcome",
        dim: true,
        steps: [
          { id: "save", target: "#save", placement: { side: "bottom" }, title: "Save your work", body: "Changes stay in this browser until you press Save." },
          { id: "done", title: "You're all set" },
        ],
      });

      document.querySelector("#start-tour").addEventListener("click", () => {
        tour.start();
      });
    </script>
  </body>
</html>
```

## Quickstart: plain JavaScript or TypeScript

```sh
npm install virtual-site-tour
```

```html
<button id="save">Save</button>
<button id="start-tour">Take the tour</button>
```

```ts
import "virtual-site-tour/base.css";
import "virtual-site-tour/theme.css";
import { createTour } from "virtual-site-tour";

const tour = createTour({
  id: "welcome",
  dim: true,
  steps: [
    {
      id: "save",
      target: "#save",
      placement: { side: "bottom", align: "start" },
      title: "Save your work",
      body: "Changes stay in this browser until you press Save.",
    },
    { id: "done", title: "You're all set", body: "Press Done to close the tour." },
  ],
});

document.querySelector("#start-tour")?.addEventListener("click", () => {
  void tour.start();
});
```

## Quickstart: React

```sh
npm install virtual-site-tour virtual-site-tour-react
```

```tsx
import "virtual-site-tour/base.css";
import "virtual-site-tour/theme.css";
import type { TourConfig } from "virtual-site-tour";
import { TourProvider, useTour } from "virtual-site-tour-react";

const config: TourConfig = {
  id: "welcome",
  dim: true,
  steps: [
    { id: "save", target: "#save", placement: { side: "bottom" }, title: "Save your work", body: "Changes stay in this browser until you press Save." },
    { id: "done", title: "You're all set" },
  ],
};

function StartTourButton() {
  const { start, isRunning } = useTour();
  return (
    <button id="start-tour" disabled={isRunning} onClick={() => void start()}>
      Take the tour
    </button>
  );
}

export default function App() {
  return (
    <TourProvider config={config}>
      <button id="save">Save</button>
      <StartTourButton />
    </TourProvider>
  );
}
```

## Quickstart: Vue

```sh
npm install virtual-site-tour virtual-site-tour-vue
```

`src/App.vue`:

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import "virtual-site-tour/base.css";
import "virtual-site-tour/theme.css";
import type { TourConfig } from "virtual-site-tour";
import { TourProvider } from "virtual-site-tour-vue";
import StartTourButton from "./StartTourButton.vue";

const config: TourConfig = {
  id: "welcome",
  dim: true,
  steps: [
    { id: "save", target: "#save", placement: { side: "bottom" }, title: "Save your work", body: "Changes stay in this browser until you press Save." },
    { id: "done", title: "You're all set" },
  ],
};
</script>

<template>
  <TourProvider :config="config">
    <button id="save">Save</button>
    <StartTourButton />
  </TourProvider>
</template>
```

`src/StartTourButton.vue`:

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { useTour } from "virtual-site-tour-vue";

const { start, isRunning } = useTour();
</script>

<template>
  <button id="start-tour" :disabled="isRunning" @click="start()">Take the tour</button>
</template>
```

## Action (gated) step

```ts
import "virtual-site-tour/base.css";
import { createTour } from "virtual-site-tour";

const tour = createTour({
  dim: true,
  steps: [
    {
      id: "click-save",
      target: "#save",
      placement: { side: "bottom" },
      title: "Try it",
      instruction: "Click <b>Save</b> to continue.",
      autoAdvance: { event: "click" },
    },
    { id: "saved", title: "Nice, it's saved" },
  ],
});

document.querySelector("#start-tour")?.addEventListener("click", () => {
  void tour.start();
});
```

## Avatar presenter

Copy `node_modules/virtual-site-tour/dist/thumbtack` to a static folder served at `/vt/thumbtack/` (Vite: `public/vt/thumbtack`). On load failure the tour falls back to the plain popover.

```ts
import "virtual-site-tour/base.css";
import "virtual-site-tour/theme.css";
import "virtual-site-tour/avatar.css";
import { createTour } from "virtual-site-tour";
import { thumbtackPack, withAvatar } from "virtual-site-tour/avatar";

const tour = createTour({
  presenter: withAvatar(thumbtackPack("/vt/"), {
    onError: (error) => console.warn(`Avatar unavailable: ${error.message}`),
  }),
  steps: [
    { id: "hello", title: "Hi, I'm Thumbtack", body: "Let me show you around." },
    { id: "save", target: "#save", placement: { side: "bottom" }, title: "Save", body: "Your work is kept here." },
  ],
});

document.querySelector("#start-tour")?.addEventListener("click", () => {
  void tour.start();
});
```

## JSON tour

```json
{
  "$schema": "https://unpkg.com/virtual-site-tour/schemas/tour.v1.schema.json",
  "format": "virtualtour-tour/1",
  "id": "welcome",
  "dim": true,
  "steps": [
    { "id": "save", "target": "#save", "placement": { "side": "bottom" }, "title": "Save your work" },
    { "id": "done", "title": "You're all set" }
  ]
}
```

```ts
import "virtual-site-tour/base.css";
import { createTour, parseTourJson } from "virtual-site-tour";

async function startWelcomeTour() {
  const response = await fetch("/tours/welcome.json");
  const tour = createTour(parseTourJson(await response.json()));
  await tour.start();
}

document.querySelector("#start-tour")?.addEventListener("click", () => {
  void startWelcomeTour();
});
```

## Public API: `virtual-site-tour`

Default export: `createTour`. Named exports: `createTour`, `Tour`, `TourStep`, `tours`, `Emitter`, `parseTourJson`, `serializeTour`, `TourJsonError`, `localStorageStore`, `memoryStore`, `TourEnvironmentError`, `TourNavigationError`, plus the types below.

```ts
function createTour(config?: TourConfig): Tour;

interface TourConfig {
  id?: string;                       // default `<name-slug>-<random>`
  name?: string;
  steps?: StepConfig[];
  stepDefaults?: Partial<StepConfig>; // merged under every step
  dim?: boolean | DimConfig;         // default false (no overlay)
  mountIn?: Element | (() => Element);
  dimMountIn?: Element | (() => Element);
  namespace?: string;                // class/attribute prefix, default "vt"
  keys?: { escape?: boolean; arrows?: boolean };
  exitPrompt?: false | string | (() => boolean | Promise<boolean>); // string uses window.confirm
  counter?: boolean | ((index: number, total: number) => string);    // true shows "1 of 3"
  labels?: { next?: string; back?: string; done?: string; close?: string };
  progress?: ProgressConfig;
  presenter?: PresenterFactory;      // e.g. withAvatar(...)
  sanitize?: (html: string) => string;
  animate?: boolean;
  waitBudget?: number;               // ms, default 10000
}

interface StepConfig {
  id?: string;                       // default step-1, step-2, ...
  title?: string | (() => string);   // HTML
  body?: BodyContent;
  label?: string | (() => string);   // accessible name when no title
  closeButton?: boolean | { label?: string | (() => string); attrs?: Record<string, string> };
  classes?: string | string[];
  meta?: JsonValue;
  buttons?: ButtonConfig[];          // replaces Next/Back
  target?: TargetRef;
  placement?: PlacementRef;
  position?: PositionOptions;
  waitFor?: number;                  // ms to wait for the target to appear
  whenMissing?: "center" | "skip";   // default "center"
  shouldShow?: () => boolean;
  prepare?: () => Promise<unknown> | unknown;
  hookTimeout?: number;              // default 10000
  spotlight?: SpotlightOptions;
  reveal?: boolean | "smooth" | ScrollIntoViewOptions;
  revealWith?: (target: Element) => void | Promise<void>;
  autoAdvance?: { event: string | string[]; selector?: string; strict?: boolean };
  instruction?: string | (() => string); // makes it an action step: Next nudges until completed
  advanceDelay?: number;             // ms a completed action step stays visible
  focus?: "dialog" | "first-button";
  extensions?: Record<string, unknown>; // e.g. { avatar: AvatarStepOptions }
}

type BodyContent = string | string[] | Element | DocumentFragment | (() => string | string[] | Element | DocumentFragment);
type TargetRef = string | Element | (() => string | Element | null | undefined);
type PlacementRef = "auto" | { side: Side | "auto" | "over"; align?: Align };
type Side = "top" | "bottom" | "left" | "right";
type Align = "start" | "center" | "end";
type JsonValue = string | number | boolean | null | JsonValue[] | { [key: string]: JsonValue };

interface PositionOptions {
  offset?: number | { main?: number; cross?: number }; // default main 10, cross 0
  viewportPadding?: number;
  boundary?: "viewport" | "scrollParents";             // default "scrollParents"
  flip?: boolean;                                      // default true
  shift?: boolean;                                     // default true
  strategy?: "fixed" | "absolute";                     // default "fixed"
  arrow?: boolean | { minInset?: number };
}

interface DimConfig {
  padding?: number;                  // default 10
  radius?: number | CornerRadius;    // default 5
  transitionMs?: number;             // default 400
  color?: string;                    // default "#000"
  opacity?: number;                  // default 0.7
  clickOutside?: "none" | "exit" | "forward"; // default "none"
  pageScroll?: boolean;              // default true
  lockScrollParent?: boolean;        // default false
  clipToScrollParents?: boolean;     // default true
}
interface CornerRadius { topLeft?: number; topRight?: number; bottomRight?: number; bottomLeft?: number }

interface SpotlightOptions {
  padding?: number;
  radius?: number | CornerRadius;
  extra?: string[];                  // more selectors to cut out
  class?: string;
  targetInteractive?: boolean | "hover-only"; // default true
}

interface ButtonConfig {
  text: string | (() => string);
  label?: string | (() => string);
  action: "forward" | "backward" | "exit" | "finish" | ((ctx: ButtonContext) => void);
  disabled?: boolean | (() => boolean);
  kind?: "primary" | "secondary";
  classes?: string | string[];
  attrs?: Record<string, string>;
}
interface ButtonContext { tour: Tour; step: TourStep }

interface ProgressConfig { store: ProgressStore; skipCompleted?: boolean /* default true */; resume?: boolean /* default false */ }
interface ProgressStore {
  load(tourId: string): Promise<ProgressRecord | null> | ProgressRecord | null;
  save(record: ProgressRecord): Promise<void> | void;
  clear(tourId: string): Promise<void> | void;
}
interface ProgressRecord { tourId: string; lastStepId?: string; completedAt?: string; exitedAt?: string; updatedAt: string }
function localStorageStore(prefix?: string): ProgressStore;
function memoryStore(): ProgressStore;

class Tour {
  readonly id: string;
  readonly name?: string;
  get steps(): readonly TourStep[];
  get currentStep(): TourStep | null;
  isRunning(): boolean;
  progressInfo(): { index: number; total: number }; // index 1-based, 0 when nothing shown
  stepById(id: string): TourStep | undefined;
  appendStep(def: StepConfig, at?: number | string): TourStep;
  dropStep(ref: string | TourStep): void;
  refresh(): void;                   // reposition
  start(): Promise<void>;
  forward(): Promise<void>;          // nudges instead on an unmet action step
  backward(): Promise<void>;
  goTo(ref?: string | number | TourStep): Promise<void>;
  advance(): void;                   // complete the current action step
  nudge(message?: string): void;
  exit(): Promise<boolean>;          // cancel (reason "api"), after exitPrompt
  finish(): void;                    // complete
  hideCurrent(): void;
  on<E extends keyof TourEvents>(e: E, fn: (payload: TourEvents[E]) => void, ctx?: object): () => void;
  once<E extends keyof TourEvents>(e: E, fn: (payload: TourEvents[E]) => void, ctx?: object): () => void;
  off<E extends keyof TourEvents>(e?: E, fn?: (payload: TourEvents[E]) => void): void;
}

type ExitReason = "close" | "escape" | "overlay" | "api" | "replaced";
interface TourEvents {
  started: { tour: Tour };
  activated: { tour: Tour };
  deactivated: { tour: Tour };
  "step-shown": { tour: Tour; step: TourStep; previous: TourStep | null };
  "step-completed": { tour: Tour; step: TourStep };
  "steps-changed": { tour: Tour };
  finished: { tour: Tour };
  exited: { tour: Tour; reason: ExitReason };
  bypassed: { tour: Tour; reason: "completed" }; // progress store says already finished
}

class TourStep {
  readonly id: string;
  readonly tour: Tour;
  get config(): Readonly<StepConfig>;
  get element(): HTMLElement | undefined | null; // the popover element while shown
  get resolvedTarget(): Element | null;
  configure(patch: StepConfigPatch): void;        // null clears a field
  show(): Promise<void>;
  hide(): void;
  exit(): Promise<boolean>;
  finish(): void;
  dispose(): void;
  isShown(): boolean;
  on<E extends keyof StepEvents>(e: E, fn: (payload: StepEvents[E]) => void, ctx?: object): () => void;
  once<E extends keyof StepEvents>(e: E, fn: (payload: StepEvents[E]) => void, ctx?: object): () => void;
  off<E extends keyof StepEvents>(e?: E, fn?: (payload: StepEvents[E]) => void): void;
}
// StepEvents keys: "will-show" | "shown" | "will-hide" | "hidden" | "completed" | "finished" | "exited" | "disposed", payload { step: TourStep }

const tours: {                        // global registry
  readonly current: Tour | null;
  on: Tour["on"]; once: Tour["once"]; off: Tour["off"]; // events from every tour
};

function parseTourJson(json: unknown, options?: { handlers?: Readonly<Record<string, (...args: never[]) => unknown>> }): TourConfig;
function serializeTour(config: TourConfig, options?: { handlerNames?: ReadonlyMap<Function, string>; elementSelectors?: ReadonlyMap<Element, string> }): TourJsonV1;
class TourJsonError extends Error { readonly path: string }
class TourEnvironmentError extends Error {} // no browser document
class TourNavigationError extends Error {}  // bad step reference
```

JSON tours use `"format": "virtualtour-tour/1"` and the same keys as `TourConfig`/`StepConfig`, except that functions become `{ "handler": "name" }`, `target`/`mountIn` are selectors, and `body` is a string or string array. Schema: `virtual-site-tour/schemas/tour.v1.schema.json`. JSON types exported: `TourJsonV1`, `StepJsonV1`, `ButtonJsonV1`, `DimJsonV1`, `CornerRadiusJson`, `HandlerRefJson`, `TextJson`, `TourJsonHandler`, `ParseTourJsonOptions`, `SerializeTourOptions`.

Also exported for custom presenters: `Presenter`, `PresenterFactory`, `PresenterContext`, `StepParts`, `RepositionInfo`, `ProgressInfo`, `StepConfigPatch`, `TourLike`, `TourStepLike`. See [presenters](https://github.com/quaz579/virtualtour/blob/main/docs/guide/presenters.md).

## Public API: `virtual-site-tour/avatar`

```ts
function withAvatar(pack: AvatarPack | NormalizedPack | Promise<AvatarPack | NormalizedPack>, options?: AvatarOptions): PresenterFactory;
function thumbtackPack(baseUrl?: string, options?: { variant?: "pushpin" | "round" }): Promise<NormalizedPack>; // baseUrl = directory holding thumbtack/
function loadAvatarPack(url: string, options?: { fetch?: typeof fetch; signal?: AbortSignal }): Promise<NormalizedPack>;
function loadClassicAvatarPack(source: ClassicSource): Promise<NormalizedPack>;
function preloadSheet(url: string, options?: { signal?: AbortSignal; timeoutMs?: number }): Promise<void>;

interface AvatarOptions {
  dock?: "start" | "end" | "auto";
  scale?: number;                    // default 1
  defaultAnimation?: string;
  idle?: boolean;                    // default true
  idleQuietMs?: number;              // default 6000
  loadTimeoutMs?: number;            // default 3000, max 9000
  onError?: (error: AvatarPackError) => void;
}
// Per step: extensions: { avatar: { animation?: string; dock?: "start" | "end" | "auto"; idle?: boolean; hidden?: boolean } }
```

Also exported: `SpeakerPresenter`, `SpritePlayer`, `IdleScheduler`, `validatePack`, `normalizePack`, `resolveRole`, `AvatarPackError` and the types `AvatarOptions`, `AvatarStepOptions`, `AvatarDock`, `AvatarPack`, `NormalizedPack`, `RoleMap`, `AvatarRole`, `AvatarDirection`, `PointRoles`, `AnimationDef`, `FrameDef`, `SheetInfo`, `BubbleHints`, `LicenseInfo`, `ClassicSource`, `LoadAvatarPackOptions`, `ThumbtackPackOptions`, `ThumbtackVariant`, `SpeakerPresenterOptions`, `SpritePlayerOptions`, `IdleSchedulerOptions`. Pack format: [make a pack](https://github.com/quaz579/virtualtour/blob/main/docs/avatar/make-a-pack.md).

## Public API: `virtual-site-tour/motion`

```ts
function glide(tour: Tour, options?: GlideOptions): () => void; // GlideOptions { durationMs?: number; easing?: string }; // animates the popover between steps; returns an undo function
function progressVars(tour: Tour): () => void; // keeps --vt-progress-index/--vt-progress-total on the popover
```

## Public API: `virtual-site-tour-react` and `virtual-site-tour-vue`

```ts
// React (react >= 18)
function TourProvider(props: { config: TourConfig; autoStart?: boolean; children?: ReactNode }): ReactElement;
function useTour(): {
  tour: Tour; isRunning: boolean; currentStep: TourStep | null;
  start(): Promise<void>; forward(): Promise<void>; backward(): Promise<void>; exit(): Promise<boolean>; finish(): void;
};

// Vue (vue >= 3.3): <TourProvider :config="config" :auto-start="true"> renders its default slot
function useTour(): {
  tour: Tour; isRunning: Readonly<Ref<boolean>>; currentStep: Readonly<Ref<TourStep | null>>;
  start(): Promise<void>; forward(): Promise<void>; backward(): Promise<void>; exit(): Promise<boolean>; finish(): void;
};
```

`config` is read once; give the provider a new `key` to rebuild the tour. Unmounting ends a running tour (reason `api`) without the exit prompt. `useTour()` throws outside a provider.

## Theming

`theme.css` reads CSS variables from `:root`: `--vt-accent`, `--vt-bg`, `--vt-fg`, `--vt-muted`, `--vt-radius`, `--vt-space`, `--vt-shadow`, `--vt-font`, `--vt-enter-duration`. Dark mode follows `prefers-color-scheme`; `data-vt-theme="dark"|"light"` on `<html>` forces one.
